traceability.notes: Story 010.1-DEV-CONFIGURABLE-PATTERNS is fully implemented. The valid-annotation-format rule accepts both nested (story/req) and flat (storyPathPattern, requirementIdPattern, storyPathExample, requirementIdExample) configuration options, with JSON Schema describing them. Custom pattern strings are compiled into RegExp instances with robust error handling: invalid patterns produce stable configuration error messages via invalidRuleConfiguration while falling back to default patterns so validation continues, preserving backward compatibility. Error messages for invalid @story and @req annotations use configurable example strings, with nested examples overriding flat shorthands and both overriding built-in defaults. Auto-fix behavior is gated by the configured patterns and remains suffix-only. Tests in tests/rules/valid-annotation-format.test.ts explicitly target all story requirements (pattern configuration, regex validation, backwards compatibility, example messaging, precedence between nested and flat forms, and fallback behavior) and all pass under Jest. User-facing documentation in user-docs/api-reference.md describes these options and how to use them alongside valid-story-reference’s storyDirectories, satisfying the documentation and integration acceptance criteria. No acceptance criteria appear unmet based on the current code, tests, and docs, so this story is assessed as PASSED.
